No. The evidence shows tree-cover loss across about 81.3 hectares in 2021, or 2.23% of the 3,643.5-hectare property—not the whole property. An additional 37.3 hectares of loss occurred in smaller patches that were not counted as events.

Most of the mapped event area was classified as planted forest. The evidence does not establish whether the loss was caused by clearing, harvesting, fire, or another cause.
